# Dosimex

> Radiation protection calculation tools — Dosismart, the Dosimex web platform, and the Dosimex Suite (17 Excel modules: gamma, X-ray, beta, neutron, internal exposure, measurement).

Dosimex (dosimex.fr) publishes radiation protection calculation tools. Dosismart (dosismart.com) is the Dosimex web platform: it is where users subscribe, download the suite, and manage their organization, and it is a browser calculation tool in its own right — gamma dose rate with volumetric source geometries, X-ray generator with NF C15-160 support, sky-shine, and a shield optimizer, with calculation history and team collaboration. The Compliance tier adds source inventory with automatic decay, a 2D radiological zoning plan editor, and regulatory workstation exposure studies (études de poste). The Dosimex Suite groups 17 MCNP-validated Excel modules covering operational dose calculations, educational modules, and measurement utilities; it remains the reference for what the web app does not cover yet (beta, neutron, gammagraphy, internal exposure, measurement). A single subscription covers both tools (Base plan €500/year excl. VAT; Compliance plan €1,350/year excl. VAT). Free 14-day Dosismart trial, technical support included.

- [Pricing](https://dosimex.fr/product): Base and Compliance plans, how to subscribe, FAQ
- [Learn](https://dosimex.fr/learn): Understanding radiation protection — 6 interactive learning modules, books, videos, training
- [References](https://dosimex.fr/references): MCNP validation files, independent comparison reports, institutional users, user feedback
- [Training](https://dosimex.fr/training): In-house training courses from 1 to 3 days
- [Documentation](https://dosimex.fr/manuals): Dosimex-GX user manuals
- [Books](https://dosimex.fr/books): Recommended readings on radiation protection and dosimetry
- [About](https://dosimex.fr/about): Team and company background
- [Contact](https://dosimex.fr/contact): Contact form for quotes and demonstrations
